zh: 海面下 1800 米。合同自动续期。
技术 / 体能 / 耐压

en: You sleep through to the wake-up call.
You come round in the infirmary.
Power dip. Lights and cameras down.
zh: 电力骤降。照明与监控失效。

en: Shift done. Report back at the next muster.
zh: 本班完成。下次点名时归队。

en: Anything on the shelf is found the moment they look.
zh: 搁板上的东西，一搜就没。

en: Nothing is made at this station.
Rebuild the hangar's one-seat sub and cut your way out to it.
zh: 把机库里那台单座潜水器修好，再割开门出去。

en: Walk onto the resupply boat in a uniform, holding paperwork that says you are owed a berth.
zh: 穿上制服，拿着写有你名字的舱位单据，直接走上补给艇。
